seo.title: Privacy Policy | CodingMonk
seo.description: How CodingMonk collects and uses the information you share through this website.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: When you book a demo, we collect the details you enter: your name, designation, college, city, state, phone number, email and anything you write in the message box.
We also store a one-way hash of your network address to prevent spam. We cannot recover your address from it.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your details only to respond to your request: to call, email or message you on WhatsApp about placement training for your college.
We do not sell your details or share them with other companies for marketing.

sections.heading: Course progress
paragraphs: Your progress in the free courses is saved only in your own browser. It is never sent to us.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask us to correct or delete your details at any time by writing to the email address below. This policy follows India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For any privacy question, email us at the address shown on the Book a demo page.
